componentsIndex.title: Components
componentsIndex.lead: {{total}} sc-* wrappers from @smartcontact-hub/components, across {{families}} families. What each one is for at a glance; open any to see its variants, states, and code, in light and dark.

blurb.button: Primary, secondary, or text action. Brand severities, sizes, and a loading state.
blurb.inputtext: Single-line text field, the foundation of every form.
blurb.textarea: Multi-line text with auto-growing height and an optional character counter.
blurb.inputnumber: Numeric input with steps, min/max, and thousands or currency formatting.
blurb.select: Single-choice dropdown, with search and option grouping.
blurb.multiselect: Pick several values from a list, with search and chips for what's chosen.
blurb.checkbox: Boolean checkbox, or multi-select within a list of options.
blurb.radiobutton: Single choice within a group of mutually exclusive options.
blurb.toggleswitch: On/off switch for settings that apply instantly.
blurb.datepicker: Date or range selection with a calendar and keyboard entry.
blurb.search: Search field with icon, quick clear, and debounce for live filtering.
blurb.inputgroup: Compose a field with attached adornments: prefix, suffix, button, or icon.
blurb.colordotpicker: Pick a color from the brand palette as a dot, to label or categorize.
blurb.photoupload: Upload and preview an image (avatar, logo) with cropping and validation.
blurb.badge: Counter or status dot over an icon or action: unread, alerts.
blurb.chip: Compact, dismissible token for active filters, tags, or selected values.
blurb.tag: Read-only status label, with brand severity and an optional color dot.
blurb.avatar: Photo, initials, or icon for a person or entity, with sizes and status.
blurb.gauge: Radial indicator of a value within a range: occupancy, progress, threshold.
blurb.datatable: Data table with header sorting, pagination, selection, and manageable columns.
blurb.columnselector: Show, hide, and reorder a table's columns by dragging.
blurb.inlinerenamecell: Rename a value in the cell itself, without opening a separate dialog.
blurb.dialog: Modal window for a focused task: form, detail, or decision.
blurb.confirmdialog: Ask to confirm an action before running it, with focus on the safe button.
blurb.deleteentitydialog: Delete confirmation with the entity's name, so you don't hit the wrong target.
blurb.impactpreviewdialog: Show what will be affected before applying a cascading change.
blurb.drawer: Side panel that slides in from the edge for details or forms without leaving the page.
blurb.grouppopover: Anchored popover to edit or choose without losing the background context.
blurb.commandpalette: Action search and keyboard navigation (⌘K), command-palette style.
blurb.keyboardshortcuts: Sheet of the available keyboard shortcuts, grouped by context.
blurb.message: Inline notice within the flow: info, success, warning, or error.
blurb.toast: Ephemeral notification that appears and dismisses itself, without blocking the screen.
blurb.emptystate: Screen when there's no data: explains what it is and offers the next step.
blurb.skeleton: Gray silhouette while content loads, so the layout doesn't jump.
blurb.progressbar: Determinate progress bar, with the percentage of a long task.
blurb.progressspinner: Loading spinner for waits of unknown duration.
blurb.card: Container with surface, shadow, and radius to group related content.
blurb.panel: Block with a header and body, collapsible, to section a page.
blurb.sectioncard: Section card with title and description to group a form's fields.
blurb.subsection: Subdivision with a light heading inside a larger section.
blurb.divider: Line or spaced margin to visually cut between blocks.
blurb.slot: Composition hole: drop any content into a pattern without coupling it.
blurb.formsectionnav: Side navigation of a long form's sections, with jump and state.
blurb.formdangerzone: The form's final zone for destructive actions: delete, deactivate.
blurb.stickyformheader: Form header that sticks to the top on scroll, with save and cancel.
blurb.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb trail of the current hierarchy, with the active step highlighted.
blurb.bulkactionbar: Bar that appears when you select rows, with the count and bulk actions.
blurb.bulkeditmenu: Menu of actions to apply to several selected rows at once.
blurb.bulktranscriptionmodal: Modal to launch batch transcription of several conversations.
